title: Boss tuning
text:
Every boss was measured against a geared tank of its own level.

⬆️ Ignara the Searing (Cinderhold) hits about a quarter less hard. She dealt half again as much damage as the bosses after her, at the second fight of the raid
⬆️ The world bosses of the Stormwake Coast and the Scorched Reach now hit like bosses: Pyraxis, Thalassor, Skarn the Ashlord and Captain Blackwake deal 50–120% more damage. They dealt about the same share of your health as Old Rendclaw at level 3
